name: Coatzacoalcos
registryBasis: The Ayuntamiento de Coatzacoalcos identifies Dirección de Catastro Municipal and publishes local cadastral procedures, while the State of Veracruz publishes Delegación Regional de Catastro Coatzacoalcos service/capacity records. The municipal public predial page permits lookup by clave catastral, but does not expose an anonymous parcel-vector response.

queries.query: Coatzacoalcos cadastral parcel map official Veracruz catastro GIS
queries.result: Found official municipal Catastro procedure/directorate pages, the municipal predial lookup, and state Catastro service records. No official anonymous cadastral parcel geometry service was found.

queries.result: Resultados oficiales evidencian deslinde de predio, Dirección de Catastro Municipal, consulta predial por clave catastral, and state Catastro Coatzacoalcos records; no public parcel-vector endpoint or safe target feature was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Coatzacoalcos Catastro procedures/predial lookup plus Veracruz state regional Catastro records and publicly indexed state GIS services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local cadastral custody and a key-based predial lookup are evidenced; no open parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or citywide parcel completeness was verified.

blocker: The current official predial viewer is an ASP.NET/Telerik page whose public form searches by clave catastral and includes payment/account panels. The fetched HTML exposed no anonymous parcel geometry API; the referenced main.js URL returned HTTP 404. Public state ArcGIS results found during discovery were environmental/land-use layers, not cadastral parcel data. No credentials, tokens, owner/address fields, or unsafe lookup fields were used.
remainingUncertainty: A municipal or state internal cadastral GIS may exist behind the key-based workflow or an unindexed service. A zero exact-point hit was not used, and no inference of citywide absence is made. Any future geometry admission requires independent qualification of the service, CRS, coverage, and stable native parcel identity.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify any authenticated-free municipal/state parcel service if discovered; retain runtime admission held pending that review.
